verified_facts: points are captured on flat unambiguous surfaces
GPS is used for ground-truth capture
each ground-truth point has plus or minus 3cm RMSE accuracy
ground-truth records include survey date and surface type
ground-truth surveys may be reused if less than five years old
coastal-project reuse limit is three years
LIDAR surveys must be below plus or minus 15cm RMSE and 10cm standard-deviation/random-error thresholds to pass QC
quality_effect: Uses EA ground truth only as independent QC/control evidence, never as a substitute candidate terrain elevation.
